🇩🇪 A1 GERMAN VOCABULARY: Küche (In the kitchen)

die Gabel = fork
das Messer = knife
der Topf = pot
die Pfanne = pan
das Geschirr = dishes
die Küche = kitchen

💡 Tip: Learn der/die/das with every noun.
